text:
talia: PR #3721 (structured-output guide + SDK examples) is blocked. Reviewer wants explicit runtime behavior for schema validation failures and whether SDKs will auto-coerce or raise. Also docs-preview failed linkcheck on an internal RFC link (403). tagging @vik and @kevin.

vik: Which RFC link?

talia: https://internal.redwood/rfcs/2026-structured-output (used in the background). Preview log shows 403 on that host and preview aborted. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3721

ci-bot: docs-preview job #700 failed: linkcheck error - https://internal.redwood/rfcs/2026-structured-output returned 403. Logs: /builds/3721/logs/700.

kevin: Runtime quick answer: when a response fails schema validation the runtime returns a 200 with a `validation` envelope: `{ status: "validation_failed", errors: [...] }`. We do NOT silently coerce model output server-side. Coercion is risky and we leave that to the client.

vik: SDK note: JS/Python SDKs will surface the validation envelope as an error object but will not attempt to coerce types. We have helpers in the SDK (e.g., `validateSchema(response, schema)`) but they are opt-in. Docs should be explicit: runtime returns validation results; SDKs do not coerce. Recommend adding a small snippet showing handling of `validation_failed` case.

talia: Good. I'll add a short code example showing check + fallback to a text-only render, and a migration note: "If you relied on implicit coercion in older SDKs, update to explicit validation helpers." Also I'll swap the RFC link to a preview-safe internal mirror path for the docs preview to avoid the 403.

schema-bot: Note: schema enforcement rollout v2 starts next week; behavior stable as described.

ci-bot: retriggered docs-preview #700 (attempt 2).

ci-bot: docs-preview #700 succeeded.

talia: Thanks @vik @kevin. Requested re-review and scheduled merge for today's window. Leaving a follow-up to add a short FAQ entry about validation envelopes and recommended client patterns.

vik: Approved.

kevin: Approved and merged in window.
